beats.text: Five things emotionally mature people do in the middle of an argument.
One. They attack the problem, not the person. No name-calling, no dredging up old wounds.
Two. They try to understand before they try to win. Winning an argument can still lose the relationship.
Three. They can say 'you might be right' without it costing them anything.
Four. They take a break before they explode — and come back, instead of walking away for good.
Five. They repair afterwards. A real apology, not a tense silence pretending to be peace.
The goal was never to defeat the other person. It was to understand, and still be close after.
